{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of Japanese language ''original series'' home video releases}} The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of ''[[Original series|Pocket Monsters]]''. ==VHS Rentals== ''[[Original series|Pocket Monsters]]'' for rental VHS is divided into four sets that were released by {{wp|Media Factory}} and [[Shogakukan]]. It contains almost all of the [[List of original series episodes|276 episodes]] between them. ===Pocket Monsters=== ''Pocket Monsters'' was released on VHS for rent by {{wp|Media Factory}} and [[Shogakukan]] between 1997 and 1999. It consists of 27 volumes with 80 episodes across them combined. ''[[Holiday Hi-Jynx|Rougela's Christmas]]'' was released separately.
